description: Source file implementing JSON-RPC interface for LinearPlaybackControl in WPEFramework plugin, including property registration, getter/setter methods for playback controls, and demuxer interaction.

classes.name: LinearPlaybackControl
classes.description: Class managing playback control via JSON-RPC, including property registration, getter/setter methods, and demuxer interactions.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all JSON-RPC properties for playback control.

methods.name: endpoint_set_channel
methods.description: Sets the channel URI for a specified demuxer ID.

methods.name: endpoint_get_channel
methods.description: Gets the channel URI for a specified demuxer ID.

methods.name: endpoint_set_seek
methods.description: Sets the seek position for a specified demuxer ID.

methods.name: endpoint_get_seek
methods.description: Gets the seek position for a specified demuxer ID.

methods.name: endpoint_set_trickplay
methods.description: Sets trick play speed and direction for a specified demuxer ID.

methods.name: endpoint_get_trickplay
methods.description: Gets trick play speed and direction for a specified demuxer ID.

methods.name: endpoint_get_status
methods.description: Retrieves TSB status information for a specified demuxer ID.

methods.name: callDemuxer
methods.description: Invokes a function on the demuxer instance, currently using a placeholder for demuxer retrieval.

methods.name: speedchangedNotify
methods.description: Notifies listeners of a change in speed.
